answer: A service analyzing pigment through a prism grants one job per source IP per hour. Its gateway verifies return routability before signing an IP-and-hour credential; workers reject invalid signatures and repeated IP-hour pairs, including an echo of a completed request. Extra influence requires additional reachable IPs, rented proxies, or waiting another hour; aliases and device reuse add no hourly quota. Shared NAT excludes legitimate users, while IPv6 address abundance can make this limit ineffective.
